backend/prisma/schema.prisma#UserPrefere: Per-user UI state such as column order and visibility.

backend/prisma/schema.prisma#Vehicle: One vehicle, owned or supplier-owned. Capacity comes from its `VehicleType`.
backend/prisma/schema.prisma#VehicleComp: Licence, insurance and deposit tracking for a vehicle, with expiry dates.
backend/prisma/schema.prisma#VehicleDepo: A deposit payment recorded against a vehicle's compliance record.
backend/prisma/schema.prisma#VehicleType: Vehicle class and `seatCapacity` — what enforces pax never exceeding capacity at assignment.
backend/prisma/schema.prisma#WebsiteSett: B2C site configuration (43 fields): branding, hero content, notification recipients and feature toggles such as AI Mode.
